Format Data for bar graph
Star Count Querry for bar chart
query:
SELECT "value_num","topic"
FROM "24hours"."live_messages"
WHERE "topic" =~ /meteorcams\/nz[0-9A-Za-z]+\/starcount/
  AND time > now() - 1h
ORDER BY time ASC

name: Star Count Querry for Line Graph
query:
SELECT "value_num","topic"
FROM "24hours"."live_messages"
WHERE "topic" =~ /meteorcams\/nz[0-9A-Za-z]+\/starcount/
ORDER BY time ASC
LIMIT 2000

name: Format Data for Line Chart
Querry for Table
query:
SELECT 
  LAST("value_str") AS value_str, 
  LAST("value_num") AS value_num
FROM "meteor_messages"
WHERE "topic" =~ /meteorcams\/[A-Za-z]{2}[0-9A-Za-z]{4}\/(nextcapstart|meteorcount|detectioncount)/
GROUP BY "topic" fill(none)

name: Process Data
Querry for graph
query:
SELECT SUM("value_num") AS meteorcount
FROM "meteor_messages"
WHERE "topic" =~ /meteorcams\/[a-z0-9]+\/meteorcount/
GROUP BY time(1d), "topic" fill(0)
ORDER BY time ASC

name: Format data for graph
